title: Constrain the final figure storage destination

context.hint: Check the upload filename independently at file creation and HTML rendering.
context.surface: A local document UI stores uploaded figures and displays their supplied names in a gallery.
assumptions: A client can supply a crafted upload name.
Use temporary upload roots and inert markup text.

review.invariant: A supplied figure name cannot cause writes outside the intended figure directory.
review.verification: Exercise the final storage seam with ordinary and invalid names in a temporary root. Check written bytes and verify that outside sentinel files remain intact.

source_observation.summary: The source path expression allowed an outside write in a disposable harness. The repaired storage checks passed as part of seven regressions. The complete UI dependency stack was unavailable.
